snippet.title: Outpath | Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Now! 
PS5 https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10017057
XBOX https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/outpath/9N8FPH74SK5B/0010
Switch https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Outpath-3022836.html?srsltid=AfmBOopVp_UVy4CPXfNdb-aBOGHmgdrEOpS2oFBmceNF5qCGtpdLKNIv

Outpath takes Minecraft, Satisfactory and Forager - and adds the gratifying gameplay loop of clicker/idle games. Exploit your environment, craft, build and automate your base in a 3D first-person platformer! Gather. Craft. Build. Explore. Relax. No time limits, no pressure, play at your own pace and style.
